For each of the following scenarios, 
determine the appropriate method of analysis:

a. A $\chi^2$ test;
b. Regression or correlation;
c. A two-sample $t$-test;
d. A paired $t$-test.

Each scenario will have only *one* correct answer.



1. As part of a project looking at the black swan in New Zealand
  (New Zealand's only large grazer of intertidal seagrass,
  and a potential threat to the seagrass), 
  a study [@data:DosSantos2012:Seagrass] 
  looked at the relationship between the body weight of herbivorous birds
  and their seagrass consumption rates.  
  What is the appropriate method of analysis?

2. Living next to construction work can be annoying, and may impact people's day-to-day living.  
  At St Thomas University (Minnesota, USA), 
  researchers examined the impact of constructing a new student accommodation building 
  close to an existing student accommodation building.  
  The study [@data:Ng2000:BuildingNoise] examined, 
  among other things, 
  the relationship between the GPA of female students (as A, B, C or D) and 
  the location of their room (central wing; far wing; near wing) 
  in the student accommodation complex 
  (which was located near a construction site) to study the impact of the construction noise.   
  What is the appropriate method of analysis?

3. A study 
   [@data:Coustumer2012:Biolilters]
   of using stormwater biofilters examined, among other things, 
   hydraulic conductivity over time when Malaleuca was used as the vegetation type 
   as the biofilter.  

   The conductivity was measured near the start (at 4 weeks) 
   and the end of the study (60 weeks), 
   and the hydraulic conductivity at both times was compared, 
   for a large number of biofilters.  

   What is the appropriate method of analysis?

4. Biodiesel is being considered as a alternative fuel.  

   To help understand the properties of biodiesel, 
   a study [@data:Gopinath2009:Iodine] studied (among other things) 
   the relationship between the iodine value 
   (the iodine value is the mass of iodine in grams that 100g of a chemical can consume) 
   and percentage weight of fatty acid methyl esters present 
   in five different biodiesel fuels.  
   
   What is the appropriate method of analysis?
